messages.guide.title: User guide
messages.guide.entryHint: New here? Learn to practice in 3 minutes
messages.guide.subtitle: Learn what this website can help you do and how to get started in just a few minutes.
messages.guide.section1.title: What this website can do
messages.guide.section1.item1: Impromptu Q&A: enter a topic, let AI create questions, and answer by speaking or typing.
messages.guide.section1.item2: Speech practice: paste or write a speech, rehearse it, and receive feedback.
messages.guide.section1.item3: AI coach feedback: get scores for structure, content, and delivery, with specific strengths and areas to improve.
messages.guide.section1.item4: Review cards: keep useful sentences and revisit them regularly.
messages.guide.section1.item5: Records: follow your progress with Calendar, your streak, and Score trends.
messages.guide.section2.title: Get started in three steps
messages.guide.section2.item1: Choose “Impromptu Q&A” or “Speech practice” on the home page.
messages.guide.section2.item3: Select “Analyze my answer ✦” (or “Analyze my manuscript ✦” for a speech) to see your AI coach’s feedback.
messages.guide.section3.title: Impromptu Q&A
messages.guide.section3.item1: Enter a topic under “What would you like to discuss?”, or select “↻ Inspire me”.
messages.guide.section3.item2: Select “Question generation” to generate three questions at a time.
messages.guide.section3.item3: Aim for 1–2 minutes per answer: state your main point, then support it with a story or example.
messages.guide.section3.item4: The daily goal is three questions. The home page shows how many you have completed today.
messages.guide.section4.title: Speech practice
messages.guide.section4.item1: Choose “Speech practice”, then enter your speech title and manuscript.
messages.guide.section4.item2: Record or type your speech, then select “Analyze my manuscript ✦” for feedback.
messages.guide.section4.item3: Your practice record saves the speech title so you can find it later.
messages.guide.section5.title: Recording and transcription
messages.guide.section5.item1: Browser live recognition (free): speech becomes text as you speak. No sign-in or AI credit is needed.
messages.guide.section5.item2: API transcription (automatic punctuation): AI converts your recording to text afterward, usually with better accuracy and automatic punctuation. Sign-in is required and AI credit is used.
messages.guide.section5.item3: You can edit the transcript before submitting it for analysis.
messages.guide.section5.item4: When recording on a phone, supported browsers keep the screen awake.
messages.guide.section5.item5: With High-quality API transcription, recorded audio is retained if the screen turns off or you switch apps. Return and select “Continue recording” to resume.
messages.guide.section5.item6: Each recording segment can last approximately 17 minutes.
messages.guide.section6.title: Understanding AI coach feedback
messages.guide.section6.item1: “Overall” and three individual scores: “Clear structure”, “Specific content”, and “Fluency”.
messages.guide.section6.item2: “What worked well” and “Try this next time”.
messages.guide.section6.item3: “Sentence Improvement & Grammar”: compare your original wording with suggested wording side by side.
messages.guide.section6.item4: English grammar: English practice includes explanations of grammar errors and correct usage.
messages.guide.section6.item5: “Improved 1–2 minute speech”: use browser text-to-speech to listen, and choose a voice and speed.
messages.guide.section7.title: Review cards
messages.guide.section7.item1: In the analysis results, check “Add to review” beside a sentence you want to remember to create a review card.
messages.guide.section7.item2: Go to “Review”, recall a better version, then select “Reveal improved sentence”. Rate your familiarity: Again, Hard, Good, or Easy.
messages.guide.section7.item3: Your rating determines the next review time. Greater familiarity gives longer intervals; “Again” brings the card back soon.
messages.guide.section7.item4: Use “Review library” to search, filter, edit, or archive cards, or set their next review dates in bulk.
messages.guide.section8.title: Calendar and score trends
messages.guide.section8.item1: “Calendar” shows practice counts and your streak. Select a day to see its practice records.
messages.guide.section8.item2: “Score trends” in the settings menu shows changes in your scores, with language and period filters.
messages.guide.section8.item3: Open any entry in “Recent practice” to revisit your answer and full report.
messages.guide.section9.title: Sign-in, AI credit, and data
messages.guide.section9.item1: No sign-in required: use the Built-in coach; your data stays in this device’s browser.
messages.guide.section9.item2: Sign in with Google to use the website’s AI coach without applying for your own API key.
messages.guide.section9.item3: AI credit: each person has a total allowance of US$1 that does not reset. Open “API costs” to see spending and credit. Once exhausted, feedback automatically switches to the built-in coach.
messages.guide.section9.item4: Cloud sync: after signing in, choose “This device only” or enable cloud sync. With sync enabled, sign into the same account on another device to access your data.
messages.guide.section9.item5: Recordings are not saved: audio is discarded after transcription. Neither the server nor the database stores recordings.
messages.guide.section10.title: Data backup
messages.guide.section10.item1: Open “Import and export data” in the settings menu. Under “Export all data”, select “Save locally” to download a backup file.
messages.guide.section10.item2: Export a backup before changing phones or clearing browser data.
messages.guide.section10.item3: “Import backup” replaces your current data with the backup contents. You will be asked to confirm first.
messages.guide.section11.title: Changing language
messages.guide.section11.item1: Use the language menu at the top right: Chinese (Traditional), English, 日本語, or العربية.
messages.guide.section11.item2: The interface and this guide immediately switch to your selected language.
messages.guide.section11.item3: AI questions and feedback also use this language.
messages.guide.section12.title: Frequently asked questions
messages.guide.section5.intro: Choose between two methods in settings:
messages.guide.section12.question1: Have several Google accounts and want to switch?
messages.guide.section12.answer1: Sign out and sign in again. You will be shown the account chooser.
messages.guide.section12.answer2: With High-quality API transcription, your recorded audio is retained. Return to the page and select “Continue recording”.
messages.guide.section12.question3: Seeing “AI credit is exhausted. Please contact the administrator.”?
messages.guide.section12.answer3: Feedback switches to the built-in coach. Contact the administrator if you need more credit.
messages.guide.section12.answer4: The segment is too long. Use Browser live recognition or record in shorter segments.
messages.guide.section12.question5: Want to see what changed on this website?
messages.guide.section12.answer5: Open “Version history” in the settings menu.
